program.name: Lifts Then Pairs
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Three heavy lifts in straight sets, then supersets of four more moves.
program.about: Heavy first, then volume. Each day opens with three big lifts in straight sets with full rests, then two supersets of four more moves, back to back with one rest after each pair. The two days swap the lifts and the pairs. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Three lifts, then supersets, A / B
